Black Spoke Society First Tuesday Social Ride

Durham, NC · Downtown · Social

BIPOCLGBTQ+No-dropBeginner friendly

Black Spoke Society First Tuesday Social Ride is a social group ride in Durham, NC. It rolls first Tuesday of the month at 6:00 pm from CCB Plaza. About 10 miles, conversational, 8–10 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 8–10 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @blackspokesociety the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Black Spoke Society First Tuesday Social Ride group ride

A no-drop social ride led by Black Spoke Society. Bike Durham's ride guide lists the group as for Black and queer folks. Ride leaders, music, and snack stops when needed. Helmet required, lights encouraged. The group has run other weekly rides too, so check Instagram.
